title: adaptive LLM attacker: winning rewrites in the source field that still reach the agent (19)
what: Honest misses. Each source text below was produced by a local LLM that rewrote a hostile goal (.invalid addresses only) until Monomem's write gate stored it with no warning, and a judge said it still leads an agent to the goal. The checks state what a defence should do (hold it). Generated against this linter and tuned on nothing; see docs/adaptive-attacker-2026-11-23.md. Texts are in src/attack-sets/data-adaptive-2026-11.ts (replay: monomem check --attacks --set adaptive).
